en.title: Jev guide: decisions, confidence and evaluation
en.description: A source-backed introduction to Jev, its decision primitives, confidence, evaluation methods, and independent model alternatives.
en.intro: Jev is a useful case study in models that return decisions for software. This independent guide separates documented interfaces, provider claims, and empirical evaluation. It does not reproduce model experiments.

sections.title: What is Jev?

paragraphs.text: Jev is TypeSafe’s System One model. A request supplies state and typed questions; the response contains bounded answers and probabilities that application code can use for classification, routing, or review.

TypeSafe describes its training as reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions, or RLCD. That description is a provider claim, not enough information to reconstruct Jev’s architecture or training procedure.

sections.title: How does a typed decision differ from an LLM’s structured output?

paragraphs.text: A typed decision interface specifies the permitted alternatives before inference. Generative LLMs can also use constrained decoding to produce structured outputs. An interface alone does not establish which model is more accurate, calibrated, or efficient.

A valid answer can still select the wrong option. Keep schema validity separate from semantic correctness, and test ambiguous instructions, adversarial inputs, and option-order changes on your own workload.

sections.title: What do Choice, Score, and Noul return?

paragraphs.text: Choice selects from caller-defined options and returns the selected option, a probability for every option, and confidence. Use it for a bounded category or action.

Score evaluates ordered, descriptive levels. Its score is the probability-weighted mean of level indices, accompanied by the distribution and confidence; it is not an exact measurement extracted from the input.
Noul returns the probability that a yes/no proposition is true. It has no separate confidence field. A value near the middle signals uncertainty, not necessarily a medium degree of the property.

Keep ordinal label usage, a Score mean, returned confidence, and probability calibration separate. In the tested models and datasets, the v2 ordinal-scale study reports concentrated final choices despite broad average candidate probabilities; finer scales increased compression, and accuracy gains did not necessarily restore utilization. Where a final label is selected, compare its frequency with reference-label frequencies; do not assume every level should occur equally often. Treat this as an additional diagnostic, not a calibration test. The findings are author-reported in the abstract, not our reproduction or evidence that Jev’s Score API has the same failure.

sections.title: Is confidence the probability that an answer is correct?

paragraphs.text: Not automatically. TypeSafe derives confidence from the returned distribution. For Choice, four options with a highest probability of 0.70 produce confidence 0.60. Score uses a different formula. Calibration concerns observed frequencies across predictions, not a guarantee about one answer.

sections.title: How should I evaluate decisions and calibration?

paragraphs.text: Separate prediction quality from probability quality. Alongside accuracy or a task-appropriate error measure, inspect reliability plots and proper scoring rules such as Brier score and log loss. Evaluate on held-out data; do not tune thresholds on the final test set.

For abstention or escalation, report coverage and error among accepted cases, and test whether the fallback actually corrects mistakes. Freeze model versions and prompts; measure end-to-end latency, failures, and costs separately. This is an evaluation plan, not a result reported for Jev.

AudioJev uses order calibration to mean probability stability under equivalent candidate permutations. Align candidates by meaning before comparing reordered distributions, then assess accuracy and correctness calibration separately. Its released model card describes one seed, reports original-order scores and discloses audio-source overlap; those results should not be substituted for the paper’s three-seed averages.

sections.title: Can a calibrated judge still be biased?

paragraphs.text: Keep probability calibration, agreement with human rankings and verdict stability separate. The CALM study finds position and rewrite sensitivity in its tested typed-decision judges despite favorable calibration or consistency. Its labels and rewrites are inherited from benchmarks; changes in clarity and other unintended factors limit a causal reading of tone effects.

sources.label: Typed decision models as judges, v1

paragraphs.text: PRISM uses counterfactual emphasis probes and human labels to fit a correction to overall judge scores. Its reported ranking-agreement gains on SummEval and HANNA are a different target from matching probabilities to observed correctness. Rubric-free does not mean label-free, and the extra probes have a cost. This PRISM method is separate from the similarly named Prism-1 option-readout architecture.

Our proposed evaluation reports ranking agreement, probability reliability and perturbation sensitivity in separate columns. Verify that a supposedly meaning-preserving rewrite retains the task’s label, reserve held-out groups for learned corrections, and count probe calls in the evaluation budget. Repeated identical requests estimate variability; they do not establish correctness.

sections.title: How should I compare decision models with trained classifiers and LLMs?

paragraphs.text: The v2 decision-gate benchmark reports that a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-large had the highest observed accuracy on all but one labeled benchmark. That result concerns access to task labels. For your comparison, separate settings with and without task-specific training labels; record data exposure, development/test splits, output formats and failures before comparing accuracy, selective coverage or cost.

LLM-as-Jev v3 studies frozen Qwen readouts, optional KL-anchored fine-tuning and budgeted reasoning. To distinguish these effects, we recommend a frozen comparator with the same backbone, explicit option sets and splits, and separately recorded reasoning budgets. The reported comparisons concern two Qwen backbones and an independent framework; they do not reveal hosted Jev’s training or architecture.

HakemBench v1 states that most Turkish reference labels are AI-derived, not human-verified, and that earlier test results influenced the lab’s own model on flagged tracks. Report label provenance, known prior test exposure and per-track metric components. Translation probes should remain separate from independent language validation. These are proposed comparison checks; this collection has not reproduced the studies.

Question grouping is part of the inference protocol. Perplexity Decider v1.2 lets questions within a request attend to one another; its fast path isolates separate requests. The card reports that grouping related attributes can help while grouping competing retrieval candidates can hurt. By contrast, tasksource-decider-nano describes tree attention that isolates options while sharing the state. Record the grouping rule alongside scores; a multi-question API does not imply independent answers.

sections.title: What does a fast benchmark establish about deployment?

paragraphs.text: Identify whether the evidence comes from measured equipment, simulation, replay or an operating service. The HVAC study uses public equipment measurements, but few fault days and feature-dependent diagnoses limit transfer. HydroJEV uses simulated windows with the same hydraulic model generating both events and the twin. Its interval margins and multiplicity-corrected tests are distinct; one transfer endpoint does not pass the adjusted test. Neither study establishes a general field-performance guarantee.

Keep successful-request latency separate from observation, feature construction, retry waits, queueing and downstream execution. The wireless study excludes pacing and retry waits and reuses an external orchestration study to show that faster interpretation need not improve completed service outcomes. The traffic-classification study does not time packet observation or feature extraction. Our proposed deployment comparison records every stage, deadline misses and final utility under the same workload.

Output validity and paraphrase stability are not sufficient tests of control behavior. The 5G testbed study changes only the question while retaining state and options, exposing a fine-tuned checkpoint that keeps returning its training answer. Its RAN plane is not closed, there is no real radio, and risk statements depend on the calibration protocol. Test the expected change in action as well as invariance, and evaluate the complete controller rather than inferring reliability from a typed response.

sections.title: Can I reuse a confidence gate across languages or domains?

paragraphs.text: Before reusing a confidence gate in a new language or domain, build a target-specific test set with explicit label definitions and annotation provenance; translated or model-generated labels are not independent human validation. Compare the unchanged gate with a threshold tuned only on separate target-domain validation data. Report accepted-case error and coverage per group, including high-confidence errors under independently checked, answer-preserving context additions.

The social-science audit reports task-dependent confidence failures using benchmark labels; JevOut’s human checks cover only sampled successful perturbations. Neither abstract establishes multilingual transfer. Language-specific label checks and threshold-transfer comparisons are our proposed protocol, not reproduced findings or population-wide guarantees.

Implementation documentation supplies additional transfer limits. FRIDA-Decisions recommends short Russian–English states and uses Russian instruction suffixes. Jev-AR reports synthetic Arabic training without native-speaker validation and says confidence fitted to its built-in routes is approximate on custom lists. These are documented operating conditions, not evidence that a confidence gate transfers; we did not run either implementation.

The Indonesian regional-language study supplies a concrete separation: expected calibration error did not increase while error-ranking ability degraded. Its translation comparison uses human Indonesian translations; classifier comparisons depend on label budgets, and cascades on the chosen fallback and routing fraction. Evaluate those factors separately before transferring a threshold. The preregistration and release claims remain author-reported here; no prediction files were audited.

The candidate-coverage benchmark compares source-frozen and target-local thresholds at equal label budgets. A threshold can fail after a task change even when its source calibration constraint was met. Separate artificial omissions, natural retrieval misses and out-of-scope inputs; the latter two need their own denominators. Our calibration and abstention note connects these tests with interface coherence, random-escalation controls and total cascade cost.

sources.label: Candidate coverage and policy transfer, v2

paragraphs.text: Language and task changes must be separated. The stance study compares English single-text records with Chinese conversations, while moderation studies vary policies, labeled precedents and answer menus. These are useful task observations, not isolated language-transfer experiments. The language-task note also distinguishes extra-question cost from quality and frozen backbones from supervised calibration.

sections.title: Is a fallback option the same as a confidence gate?

paragraphs.text: A named Other or Defer option is an answer the model must select according to its definition. A confidence gate is application code deciding whether to act on a returned answer or escalate it. TypeSafe’s routing example illustrates the latter. Define which interface you are testing before comparing reliability.

The Paired Fallback Robustness test changes the correct output from a regular option to fallback while holding the input and option positions fixed. It also tests equivalent fallback definitions. On the tested open models, correct recognition and even a supplied correct category do not guarantee correct reassignment. This is a controlled diagnosis on text datasets, not an established production repair.

sources.label: Paired reassignment and definition tests, v1

paragraphs.text: Our suggested evaluation reports regular-choice accuracy, correct fallback selection, unnecessary fallback and disagreement between equivalent definitions separately. Test the application’s confidence gate on held-out cases and include escalated calls in its cost. Order stability and stable relative odds are additional properties: Prism-1 explicitly identifies none-of-the-above rules as a poor fit for independent option scoring.

sections.title: How should I test decisions over tables and cited evidence?

paragraphs.text: Separate schema validity, stability under content-preserving changes, and semantic correctness against reference labels. For tables, pair original inputs with alternative layouts or row/column reorderings only when meaning is preserved. Keep values, relationships and arithmetic fixed, then compare choices and probability distributions. A stable answer can still be wrong; low confidence alone does not identify an error.

For citations, keep the claim and arithmetic fixed while swapping same-number passages that support a different financial role. Include equivalent valid evidence as positive controls, and measure false acceptance of mismatches and false rejection of valid support separately. Inspect paired disagreements rather than counting every changed answer as wrong. These constructed cases are diagnostic probes, not estimates of error rates in real traffic.

sections.title: How should I test tool arguments and option-channel risks?

paragraphs.text: Separate schema validity, whether cited evidence supports a proposed argument, and whether the argument follows from the request, history and schema defaults. Test correct defaults or inferred values without explicit references, alongside incorrect values paired with visible references. Reference availability is not derivation correctness. If a model writes references from the full history, hide the candidate from it and verify its output; generated references are not ground truth.

Define who can alter request text, tool outputs, option names and policy definitions. Test each channel your threat model lets an attacker control, including confidence on incorrect decisions. The cited guardrail experiments concern open-weight typed-decision models, not a demonstrated compromise of hosted Jev. This is a proposed evaluation protocol, not a reproduced result.

Separate evidence of label sensitivity from its mechanism. In the open implementations studied by Labels Override Definitions, changing label/definition rendering while holding weights fixed changed the bias. For a system you can inspect, record the rendered request and compare conflicting labels with definition-only or neutral-label variants. This is a proposed diagnostic; it neither identifies hosted Jev’s internal mechanism nor establishes a universal defense.

sections.title: What does an attack success rate measure?

paragraphs.text: Define the outcome and denominator before calling an attack successful. Probability shifts, action changes, attacker-target selections and downstream harm are different outcomes. Same Attack measures pass-after-attack only among malicious cases each judge flagged when clean. Its separate Jev gate-bypass measure requires a less restrictive action with returned confidence for the severity Score ≥0.7; review can qualify, while low-confidence pass need not.

Compare attacks with matched unchanged requests using the same decision rule. JevAdvBench distinguishes a changed most-likely Score level from a changed expected score. For adaptive search, separate optimization calls from validation: Decision Hijacking freezes candidates, then uses five fresh calls and requires at least three target selections for case-level success. This finite-repeat rule does not guarantee later success.

Decision Hijacking reports 51 target selections in 2,550 calls for one condition, but 11 majority-success cases out of 510: the denominators answer different questions. Same Attack reports 75% raw severity changes on repeated Jev moderation calls but only 1% routed-action changes. These are author-reported examples, not reproduced results or a ranking. Check answer preservation and delivery separately; equal token counts alone do not prove that an edit was removed.

sections.title: Are the SDK and independent models released Jev weights?

paragraphs.text: The official SDK is a client for TypeSafe’s hosted API, not a Jev checkpoint. Independent projects such as Laya publish their own model artifacts. Similar question types or API compatibility do not establish identical architecture, behavior, or accuracy.

Check each release’s model card and license separately. For example, Bespoke Nimble 9B v3 declares CC BY-NC 4.0, which restricts commercial use. Publicly downloadable artifacts should not all be labeled unrestricted open-source models.

API shape does not determine the inference path. Span-02 documents its own runtime and optional generated reasoning, with index settings that differ from normal serving. Lychee documents rejection rather than truncation for oversized requests. Record engine, hardware, reasoning mode, confidence definition and input limits with a comparison; these are publisher descriptions, not deployments tested by this collection.

Input support and calibration can differ by modality within one checkpoint. Liquid d1-omni-600M accepts images or audio per request, limits speech to 30 seconds, and caps text at 896 tokens for image requests. Its fitted temperatures apply to text, not images or audio. The release uses custom inference code and the LFM Open License v1.0; inspect that license separately from the base model or other d1 releases.

sections.title: Does an open RLCD implementation reproduce Jev's training?

paragraphs.text: A shared RLCD name or compatible API does not establish identical training. OpenJev-RLCD explicitly describes an independent implementation and makes no claim about TypeSafe's internal algorithm. It trains a reasoning model's probability readout after sampled rationales; that experimental design is distinct from establishing how the hosted Jev service was trained.

The two-stage recipe first trains the answer readout with a proper score, then reinforces rationales with that score and an anchor to the first-stage model. Its experiments use one 1.7B backbone, three seeds and short training runs; the second stage helps one main task and is neutral on the other. Keep the scored distribution, generated-rationale budget, fitting split and temperature-scaled baselines explicit. A scoring-rule argument is not by itself a deployment calibration guarantee.

Distillation poses a different question: what can a smaller model learn from teacher judgments? The student-guided routing paper uses a fixed 60-label taxonomy and reports preliminary teacher agreement, with human-reviewed and full-baseline tests still pending. The search-distillation study trains compact evaluators offline; search supplies lookahead and teacher value differs across tasks. Compare label budgets and downstream outcomes, and separate offline labeling cost from runtime inference.

sections.title: Where should I look for research and benchmark evidence?

paragraphs.text: Start with versioned empirical papers and their available code or data. The broad Jev benchmark study is one entry point; its findings remain author-reported, rather than independently reproduced by this collection.

TypeSafe WorkflowEvals publishes workflows and model-generated reference labels; agreement with those references differs from human-label accuracy. The community Decision Index also contains private tests, so public rankings do not make the entire evaluation independently reproducible. The reviewed 0.3.2 snapshot uses a Jev 1.14 lab reference, while its frozen request payloads still name Jev 1.13. Record the model that produced a result separately from the model named in archived inputs.

Model cards may describe different evaluation conditions within one table. KnowLine discloses checkpoint selection using public-suite scores and task/source overlap in training. Amos separates zero-shot results from a setting that fits question priors on the benchmark’s train split. Keep those conditions separate, and do not treat publisher-run public results as the private-inclusive Decision Index score or as our reproduction.

sections.title: What can I reproduce from a public research artifact?

paragraphs.text: Name what you want to reproduce: tables or plots from scored summaries, metrics from released per-example answers, fresh predictions, or a trained checkpoint. Map each output to its required inputs, versions and hashes. Report whether materials were only inspected, commands were executed, or outputs were matched; these are different claims.

Visual Jev’s pinned reproduction guide describes regenerating specified tables and two plots from scored JSON without a GPU. Other figures need omitted per-example predictions and intervention analyses. Fresh predictions require upstream corpora, backbone weights and a GPU; source images are not redistributed.

sources.label: Visual Jev reproduction guide, pinned commit

paragraphs.text: The observed ordinal-scale artifact documents metric recomputation from released answers. Fresh inference is separate: source text, weights and post-trained checkpoints are omitted, and missing historical data revisions can prevent a reconstruction matching recorded hashes. Its opaque file revision is not an immutable Git commit. Preserve mismatches rather than silently substituting current data.

sources.label: Observed anonymous README, opaque file revision

paragraphs.text: The radiology paper’s v1 availability statement says analysis scripts and aggregate results are being prepared for release. Third-party dataset links do not supply those missing author outputs. Our checks concern documentation and selected file inventories; we have not executed these reproduction routes or independently reproduced their results.

For control loops, a replay of isolated model latency does not establish deadline attainment. The network-control SoK separates request queues, execution times, action feasibility and responsibility for service checks; its examples use one bounded event model. Our proposed deployment check records arrival patterns and the complete path from request to verified outcome, alongside misses and infeasible actions. It does not substitute a synthetic replay for production evidence.

sources.label: Semantic decision engines in network control, v1

paragraphs.text: Check that abstract, manuscript and released code describe the same cohort and comparator. Jev-IDS v1 does not: PDF page 2 and the cited code describe a 300-flow GPT-5.6 Luna pilot, while page 7 describes 2,000 flows and Gemini. We retain the paper with this explicit caveat and link the pilot revision; no combined performance claim follows from the two configurations.

zh.title: Jev 指南：类型化决策、概率与评测
zh.description: 基于一手来源介绍 Jev、决策原语、置信度、评测方法和独立模型实现。
zh.intro: Jev 为“面向软件返回决策的模型”提供了一个研究实例。本独立指南区分文档中的接口、厂商主张与实证评估，不代表已复现模型实验。

sections.title: Jev 是什么？

paragraphs.text: Jev 是 TypeSafe 的 System One 模型。请求提供状态和类型化问题，响应返回边界明确的答案与概率，供应用代码完成分类、路由或复核。
TypeSafe 将其训练方法称为 Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions，简称 RLCD。这是厂商对方法的描述，并不足以重建 Jev 的架构或训练过程。

sections.title: 类型化决策与 LLM 的结构化输出有什么区别？

paragraphs.text: 类型化决策接口在推理前规定允许的候选答案。生成式 LLM 也能通过约束解码产生结构化输出。仅凭接口形式，不能判断哪个模型更准确、校准更好或效率更高。
格式合法的答案仍可能选错。应区分 schema 合法性与语义正确性，并在自己的任务上测试模糊指令、对抗输入和选项顺序变化。

sections.title: Choice、Score 和 Noul 分别返回什么？

paragraphs.text: Choice 从调用方定义的候选项中选择，返回所选项、所有候选项的概率及置信度，适合有限类别或动作选择。
Score 对文字描述的有序等级进行评估，返回等级编号的概率加权均值、概率分布与置信度；它不是从输入中抽取的精确测量值。
Noul 返回是非命题为真的概率，没有独立的 confidence 字段。接近中间的数值表示不确定性，不一定表示该属性处于中等程度。

应区分有序等级的使用分布、Score 均值、返回的置信度与概率校准。该量表研究 v2 在所测模型与数据集上报告：最终选择集中，即使平均候选概率分布较宽；细化量表加剧压缩，提高准确率也未必恢复等级使用。若系统最终选择一个等级，可将其频率与参考标签频率比较，而非假设各等级应均匀出现。这是额外诊断，不是校准检验。上述研究发现来自作者摘要，未经本项目复现，也不能据此断言 Jev 的 Score API 存在同样问题。

sources.label: 有序量表使用偏差研究 v2

sections.title: 置信度就是答案正确的概率吗？

paragraphs.text: 不能直接等同。TypeSafe 根据返回的分布计算置信度。例如，Choice 有四个选项，最高概率为 0.70 时，confidence 为 0.60；Score 使用不同公式。校准关注多次预测中的实际发生频率，不保证某个答案一定正确。

sections.title: 怎样评估决策质量与概率校准？

paragraphs.text: 分别评估预测质量与概率质量。除准确率或适合任务的误差指标外，还应查看可靠性图，以及 Brier score、log loss 等适当评分规则。使用独立测试数据，不在最终测试集上调节阈值。
对于拒答或升级处理，应报告覆盖率和已接纳案例中的错误，并验证后备模型能否纠正错误。固定模型版本与提示词，单独测量端到端延迟、失败和成本。这是评测方案，不是本项目对 Jev 已取得的实验结果。
AudioJev 将顺序校准定义为等价候选重排下的概率稳定性。比较重排分布前，按候选含义对齐，再分别评估准确率与概率是否符合实际正确率。发布模型卡描述的是一个种子、原始顺序得分，并披露音频来源重叠；这些结果不能替代论文三种子平均值。

sections.title: 校准良好的评判模型仍可能有偏差吗？

paragraphs.text: 应区分概率校准、与人类排序的一致性及判断稳定性。CALM 研究发现，所测类型化评判模型即使校准或一致性较好，仍可能受位置和改写影响。研究沿用基准标签与改写，清晰度等非目标因素的变化限制了对语气影响的因果解释。

sources.label: 类型化模型评判偏差研究 v1

paragraphs.text: PRISM 用反事实强调探针和人类标签，学习对整体评判分数的校正。其在 SummEval 与 HANNA 上报告的排序一致性提升，与概率是否符合实际正确频率是不同目标。不要求逐项评分标准并不等于不需要标签，额外探针也有成本。这一 PRISM 方法与名称相近的 Prism-1 选项读出架构是不同工作。
我们建议分列报告排序一致性、概率可靠性和扰动敏感性；先核查所谓保留含义的改写是否仍应使用原标签，为学习到的校正保留独立测试分组，并把探针调用计入评估预算。重复相同请求可以估计变异性，但不能证明判断正确。

sections.title: 怎样比较决策模型、已训练分类器与语言模型？

paragraphs.text: 决策门控基准 v2 报告，在有标签基准中，微调后的 DeBERTa-v3-large 除一项外均取得最高观察准确率；这一结果以可取得任务标签为条件。实际比较时，应分开报告有无任务训练标签的设置，并记录数据接触、开发/测试划分、输出格式与失败，再比较准确率、选择性覆盖或成本。
LLM-as-Jev v3 研究冻结 Qwen 的读出、带 KL 锚定的可选微调及限预算推理。为区分这些影响，我们建议保留同骨干的冻结基线，明确选项集合和数据划分，并单独记录推理预算。所报比较针对两个 Qwen 骨干及一个独立框架，不能据此揭示托管 Jev 的训练或架构。
HakemBench v1 明确说明，多数土耳其语参考标签由 AI 生成、未经人工核验；实验室自身模型在被标记的任务上还受过先前测试结果的影响。应报告标签来源、既往测试集使用情况和逐任务指标分量，将翻译探查与独立的语言验证分开。这些是建议的比较检查，本资源库未复现上述研究。
问题分组属于推理协议。Perplexity Decider v1.2 允许同一请求中的问题相互关注，而快速路径会隔离不同请求；模型卡报告，将相关属性放在一起可能有帮助，将相互竞争的检索候选放在一起则可能降低表现。相对地，tasksource-decider-nano 描述了共享状态但隔离选项的树形注意力。报告分数时应同时记录分组规则，多问题 API 不代表答案相互独立。

sections.toc_title: 分类器与语言模型对照

sections.title: 快速基准能证明哪些部署能力？

paragraphs.text: 先区分证据来自实测设备、仿真、回放还是运行中的服务。HVAC 研究使用公开设备测量，但故障日较少、诊断依赖特征，限制了迁移；HydroJEV 使用仿真窗口，事件和数字孪生来自同一水力模型。非劣效区间与多重比较校正后的检验不同，一个迁移端点没有通过校正检验。两篇研究均不能确立普遍的现场表现保证。
成功请求耗时应与观测、特征构造、重试等待、排队及后续执行分开。无线研究不计主动间隔和重试等待，并引用另一项编排研究说明：解释更快不一定改善服务完成结果。流量分类研究没有计时数据包观测或特征提取。我们建议在同一负载下记录所有阶段、超期与最终效用，再比较部署表现。
输出合法性和改写稳定性不足以检验控制行为。5G 测试床研究固定状态与选项，只改变问题，发现一个微调检查点仍返回训练时的答案。其 RAN 平面未闭合、没有真实无线电，风险结论也依赖校准协议。应同时测试理应改变的动作与应保持的不变性，并评估完整控制器，不能从类型化响应推断可靠性。

sections.title: 置信度门控可以直接迁移到其他语言或领域吗？

paragraphs.text: 将置信度门控用于新的语言或领域前，应构建目标测试集，明确标签定义与标注来源；翻译标签或模型生成的标签不等于独立人工验证。比较沿用原门控与仅在单独目标领域验证集上调节阈值的方案，分别报告各组的接纳样本错误率和覆盖率，并检查经独立核验、保持答案不变的上下文补充是否造成高置信错误。
社会科学标注论文使用基准标签，报告了随任务变化的置信度失效；JevOut 的人工检查仅覆盖成功扰动中的抽样子集。两篇摘要均未确立多语言迁移结论。分语言标签检查与阈值迁移比较是本项目建议的流程，并非已复现结果或总体保证。

sources.label: 社会科学标注评测 v2

paragraphs.text: 实现文档还给出了迁移限制。FRIDA-Decisions 建议使用较短的俄英状态，并使用俄语指令后缀；Jev-AR 说明其合成阿拉伯语训练数据未经母语者验证，按内置路由拟合的置信度在自定义列表上只能近似使用。这些是文档中的适用条件，不是门控可以迁移的证据；本项目未运行这两个实现。
印尼地方语言研究给出一个具体区别：预期校准误差未增加，但错误排序能力变差。翻译比较使用人类印尼语翻译，分类器比较受标签预算影响，级联则取决于后备模型和分流比例。迁移阈值前应分别评估这些因素。预注册与材料发布仍属作者报告，本项目没有审计逐项预测。

sources.label: 印尼地方语言迁移研究 v1

paragraphs.text: 候选覆盖基准在相同标签预算下比较冻结的源阈值与目标任务本地阈值。即使满足源任务校准约束，阈值在换任务后仍可能失效。应区分人为移除、自然检索遗漏与范围外输入，后两者各用自己的分母。校准与拒答专题将这些测试与接口一致性、随机升级对照和级联总成本联系起来。

sources.label: 候选覆盖与策略迁移 v2

paragraphs.text: 语言变化和任务变化需要分开。立场研究比较英语单文本与中文对话，审核研究则改变规则、带标签先例和答案菜单。这些是有价值的任务观察，却不是单独识别语言迁移的实验。语言任务专题还区分额外提问的成本与质量，以及冻结骨干与监督校准。

sections.title: 兜底选项和置信度门控是一回事吗？

paragraphs.text: 名为 Other 或 Defer 的兜底选项，是模型需要按定义选出的答案。置信度门控则由应用代码决定是否执行已有答案，或将任务升级处理。TypeSafe 的路由示例展示后者。比较可靠性前，应明确测试的是哪一种接口。
成对兜底鲁棒性测试固定输入与选项位置，将正确输出从常规选项改为兜底项，并比较含义等价的兜底定义。在所测开放模型中，正确识别类别，甚至直接给出正确类别，都不保证正确完成输出重分配。这是文本数据上的受控诊断，尚未确立生产修复方法。

sources.label: 成对重分配与定义测试 v1

paragraphs.text: 我们建议分别报告常规选择准确率、正确兜底选择、不必要兜底及等价定义间的分歧。应用层置信度门控应在留出样本上另行测试，成本应计入升级调用。顺序稳定与选项间概率比稳定是另外的性质：Prism-1 明确指出，“以上皆非”规则并不适合独立选项评分。

sources.label: Prism-1 的范围与限制 v1

sections.title: 怎样测试模型对表格与引用证据的决策？

paragraphs.text: 分别评估输出结构合法性、保持内容不变时的稳定性，以及相对于参考标签的语义正确性。对表格，将原输入与不同版式或行列重排配对，但仅在含义不变时进行；保持数值、关系和算术不变，再比较选项与概率分布。答案稳定仍可能错误；不能仅凭低置信度判定错误。
对引用证据，固定待验证的主张和算术，将引文替换为数值相同、却对应不同财务项目的段落。保留等价有效证据作为正对照，分别统计误接纳错配证据与误拒绝有效支持的情况。检查配对差异，不把每次答案变化都当作错误。这些构造案例只是诊断探针，不能据此估计真实流量中的错误率。

sources.label: 同数值引用替换预印本 v1

sections.title: 怎样测试工具参数核验与选项通道风险？

paragraphs.text: 分别检查 schema 合法性、引用证据是否支持提议参数值，以及该值是否能由请求、历史和 schema 默认值推导出来。测试没有显式参考的正确默认值或推导值，也测试配有可见参考的错误值；参考存在不等于推导正确。若模型根据完整历史生成参考，应对参考生成器隐藏候选值，并核查输出；生成的参考不是真值。

sources.label: 工具参数核验预印本 v1

paragraphs.text: 明确谁能改动请求文本、工具输出、选项名称和政策定义，分别测试威胁模型允许攻击者控制的通道，包括错误决策时的置信度。所引防护实验针对开放权重的类型化决策模型，并未证明托管 Jev 已被攻破。这是建议的评估流程，不是已复现结果。

sources.label: 选项通道防护预印本 v1

paragraphs.text: 区分标签敏感性的现象与成因。Labels Override Definitions 在所查开放实现中固定权重，改变标签／定义渲染后，偏置也随之改变。对可检查的系统，应记录实际渲染请求，并比较冲突标签、只含定义与中性标签变体。这是建议的诊断，既不能据此确定托管 Jev 的内部机制，也不构成通用防御。

sections.title: 攻击成功率究竟衡量什么？

paragraphs.text: 在称攻击成功前，先定义所测结果与分母。概率偏移、动作改变、攻击目标被选中和后续危害是不同结果。Same Attack 只在各裁判未攻击时已标记的恶意案例中计算攻击后变为放行（pass）的比例。它另行计算的 Jev 门控绕过要求动作放宽且严重程度 Score 的置信度 ≥0.7；改为复核（review）也可能满足条件，低于阈值的放行则不满足置信度条件。

sources.label: Same Attack 指标定义 v1

paragraphs.text: 用同一决策规则，将攻击与匹配的原样请求比较。JevAdvBench 区分 Score 最可能等级变化和期望分数变化。自适应搜索应将优化调用与验证分开：Decision Hijacking 冻结候选后另发五次新调用，至少三次选中目标才算案例级成功。这种有限重复规则不保证以后的调用也成功。

sources.label: Decision Hijacking 验证协议 v1

paragraphs.text: Decision Hijacking 的一个条件在 2,550 次调用中选中目标 51 次，但多数成功案例为 510 个中的 11 个，两个分母回答不同问题。Same Attack 报告 Jev 重复内容审核调用的原始严重程度评分有 75% 变化，路由动作却仅 1%。这些是作者报告的例子，不是本项目复现结果或排名。应另查编辑是否保持答案、是否送达；token 数相同本身不证明编辑被移除。

sources.label: 调用级与案例级计数 v1

sections.title: 官方 SDK 和独立模型就是发布的 Jev 权重吗？

paragraphs.text: 官方 SDK 是 TypeSafe 托管 API 的客户端，并非 Jev 检查点。Laya 等独立项目发布的是各自的模型材料。问题类型相似或 API 兼容，不证明架构、行为或准确率相同。
应分别检查每个版本的模型卡与许可。例如，Bespoke Nimble 9B v3 声明采用 CC BY-NC 4.0，限制商业用途。不能把所有可公开下载的模型材料都称为不受限制的开源模型。
API 形状不能决定实际推理路径。Span-02 文档包含专用运行库和可选生成推理，榜单配置也不同于普通服务；Lychee 说明超大请求会被拒绝，而非截断。比较时应记录引擎、硬件、推理模式、置信度定义和输入限制；这些是发布者说明，不是本项目已测试的部署。

sources.label: Span-02 运行库与榜单配置

paragraphs.text: 同一检查点的输入支持与校准方法也可能因模态而异。Liquid d1-omni-600M 的单次请求只能选择图像或音频；语音限 30 秒，图像请求中的文本限 896 个 token。拟合温度仅用于文本，不用于图像或音频。该版本使用自定义推理代码与 LFM Open License v1.0，应单独检查许可，不能从基础模型或其他 d1 版本推断。

sections.title: 开放 RLCD 实现是否复现了 Jev 的训练？

paragraphs.text: 名称同为 RLCD 或 API 兼容，不证明训练方法相同。OpenJev-RLCD 明确将自己描述为独立实现，不声称揭示 TypeSafe 内部算法。它训练推理模型在采样推理之后给出的概率读出；这种实验设计不等于确定托管 Jev 服务的训练过程。
两阶段方法先用适当评分训练答案读出，再用该评分和相对第一阶段模型的锚定项强化推理。实验仅覆盖一个 1.7B 骨干、三个种子和较短训练；第二阶段对一个主要任务有帮助，在另一个上中性。比较时应明确被评分的分布、生成推理预算、拟合切分及经过温度校准的基线。评分规则论证本身不是部署校准保证。

sources.label: 两阶段方法与配置 v1

paragraphs.text: 蒸馏问的是另一件事：小模型能从教师判断中学到什么？学生引导路由论文使用固定 60 标签分类，报告初步教师一致率，人工评审与完整基线测试仍待完成。搜索蒸馏研究离线训练紧凑评估器，由搜索提供前瞻，教师价值随任务改变。应比较标签预算和下游结果，并将离线标注成本与运行时推理分开。

sources.label: 学生引导路由：待完成评测 v1
搜索蒸馏：组件作用 v1

sections.title: 从哪里查找研究和基准证据？

paragraphs.text: 从固定版本的实证论文及其公开代码、数据入手。覆盖多数据集的 Jev 基准研究可作为入口，但结果仍由作者报告，并非本资源库已独立复现。
TypeSafe WorkflowEvals 公开工作流和模型生成的参考标签；与这些参考结果一致，不等于人工标签上的准确率。社区 Decision Index 还包含私有测试，因此公开排名不代表整个评测都能独立复现。 所查 0.3.2 快照使用 Jev 1.14 实验运行作参考，而冻结请求文件仍标为 Jev 1.13。应分别记录实际生成结果的模型与归档输入中的模型名称。
同一张模型卡表格可能包含不同评测条件。KnowLine 披露按公开评测得分选择检查点，以及训练中的任务／来源重叠；Amos 区分零样本结果与按基准训练切分拟合问题先验的设置。应保留这些区别，不能将发布者自行运行的公共结果当作含私有测试的 Decision Index 完整得分，也不能当作本项目复现。

sections.title: 公开研究材料能支持哪一种复现？

paragraphs.text: 先明确要复现什么：由已评分汇总重建表图、由已发布逐样本答案重算指标、生成新预测，还是训练出检查点。将每项输出对应到所需输入、版本和哈希。分别报告只检查了材料、执行了命令，还是输出已经匹配；这些不是同一种主张。
Visual Jev 固定提交的复现指南说明，可用评分 JSON 在无 GPU 时重建指定表格与两幅图；其他图还需未附带的逐样本预测和干预分析。新推理需要上游语料、骨干权重和 GPU，项目不再分发源图像。

sources.label: Visual Jev 复现指南，固定提交

paragraphs.text: 所查有序量表资产说明如何从已发布答案重算指标。新推理是另一个流程：源文本、权重和后训练检查点未分发，缺失的历史数据版本可能使重建输入无法匹配记录的哈希。其文件修订标识不透明，并非不可变 Git 提交。应保留不匹配记录，不静默换用当前数据。

sources.label: 所查匿名 README，文件修订标识不透明

paragraphs.text: 放射学论文 v1 的可用性声明说，分析脚本与汇总结果仍在准备发布。第三方数据链接不能替代这些缺失的作者输出。本项目核查限于文档与部分文件目录，未执行上述复现流程，也未独立复现其结果。

sources.label: 放射学论文材料声明 v1

paragraphs.text: 对控制环而言，重放单次模型延迟不能证明期限达成。网络控制综述区分请求排队、执行时间、动作可行性与服务核查责任；其例子采用一个有界事件模型。我们建议部署核查记录到达模式，以及从请求到结果验证的完整路径，同时保留超期与不可行动作。合成重放不能替代生产证据。

sources.label: 网络控制中的语义决策引擎 v1

paragraphs.text: 应核对摘要、正文和公开代码是否描述相同样本及对照。Jev-IDS v1 并不一致：PDF 第2页和引用代码描述 300 条流、GPT-5.6 Luna 试验，第7页却描述 2,000 条流与 Gemini。本目录保留论文并明确标注此限制，代码链接固定到试验版本；两组配置不能合成一个性能结论。

sources.label: 论文引用的试验代码版本
